purpose: Starts an action or a navigation that the person names with a visible label. Variant says the intent (brand, neutral, destructive) and Appearance how loud it is, so one solid brand Button marks the main action of a view.

notFor.case: The action is shown by an icon alone, with no visible label.
Dismissing an alert, toast, dialog or tag with an X.
A destination or small action inside running text.
The one primary action that floats over the screen's content.

Default.visual: The Variant x Appearance roles: solid default is Action/primary/default with Content/on-action; secondary is Action/secondary/default with Content/on-secondary; critical solid is Status/critical/surface-solid with Status/critical/on-solid; outline adds a Border/accent (or Status/critical/border-strong) edge; link uses Content/link/default. Solid fills carry Elevation/highlight.

Hover.visual: Each fill moves to its hover role (Action/primary/hover, Action/secondary/hover, Status/critical/surface-solid-hover); outline and ghost gain Action/ghost/hover (Status/critical/surface for critical); link ink moves to Content/link/hover.

Pressed.visual: Fills move to their pressed role (Action/primary/pressed, Action/secondary/pressed, Action/ghost/pressed, Status/critical/surface-solid-pressed, Status/critical/surface-pressed).

Focused.visual: The Default look plus a ring set 1px outside the edge: Border/ring/default for brand, Border/ring/neutral for secondary, Status/critical/ring for critical.

Loading.meaning: The action is running; the label stays.
Loading.visual: The Default look with a spinner in place of the leading icon.

Disabled.visual: Action/disabled/default fill (solid), Border/control edge (outline) and Content/disabled ink; no highlight.

a11y.role: button (native <button>, or the child element with asChild)
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it; Enter or Space activates it (native button).
notes: The visible label is the accessible name; it is always shown.
Disabled sets aria-disabled; Loading sets aria-busy.
Colours, edge and ink move with the motion role use-hover; the focus ring with use-focus (recipes/motion.ts).

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the hover and press transitions (use-hover, including the scale) be dropped, or only shortened?
Loading: should a loading Button also block clicks and announce progress, or does aria-busy alone cover it?
